picks.reasoning: HLE has the stronger players lane for lane, starting with the top side, and in a single game the better individuals win. I don't care how loud the TES hype gets. They're still the weaker team man for man.

HLE plays clean, fast early setups: they grab first herald, put deep wards in, and choke the map before 15 minutes. TES likes to scrap, but scrapping without tempo just hands HLE the map, and in a best of 1 the team that sets the pace usually wins.

HLE's draft prep is tighter and Zeka can play a deeper mid pool, which matters more when a Bo1 comes down to a single draft. TES can win a skirmish-heavy game, but I trust HLE to out-draft them and grind out a controlled win.

HLE's records against international opponents have been more consistent over the last year, but I have no head-to-heads or game-length data from this event, and a best of 1 is close to a coin flip. I lean slightly toward HLE and won't push it higher until the numbers back it up.
HLE come into Worlds as a settled, trusting unit, and in a single game that calm counts for a lot. TES can be brilliant, but when their mood swings they can come apart under Swiss pressure.
